headline: US-Backed EASE Secures $9.5M to Expand Medical AI in South Africa and Ghana
summary: New York-based AAFC Group invested $9.5 million in medical-equipment financing firm EASE to deploy advanced scanners and surgical robots in South Africa and Ghana.
why: Venture capital investments in healthcare technology infrastructure enable expansion into emerging market medical sectors.

impacts.name: South Africa
impacts.why: Foreign capital inflows support medical infrastructure development in target countries.
